name: Interactive Glyph Placement for Tensor Fields
definition: An iterative glyph packing algorithm for tensor fields that uses a Delaunay triangulation acceleration structure to speed up clustering and neighborhood searches, avoiding re-computation when planes move through a volume.
summary: Interactive Glyph Placement for Tensor Fields is an iterative particle-system algorithm that densely distributes tensor glyphs to minimize overlap while preserving local information, distinguished by its parameter-less Delaunay triangulation acceleration for interactive exploration.
